assumptions.choice: Cancel active stop loss order, close existing open position, and enter opposite position when opposite MACD histogram zero crossover occurs
assumptions.reason: The specification states that entries are triggered by zero-line crossovers for both long and short trades. When holding a long (short) position and a cross below (above) zero occurs, reversing the position fulfills the entry requirement for the new direction.

assumptions.choice: Submit a stop order via bt.Order.Stop at 2% below long execution price or 2% above short execution price in notify_order upon entry completion
assumptions.reason: The specification specifies a 2% stop-loss from entry price on each trade.
